question: Which Europe-wide balancing platform pools the opposite imbalances of the participating TSOs without ranking energy bids on common merit order lists?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 22(2) of Regulation 2017/2195 says the imbalance netting platform consists of the imbalance netting process function and the TSO-TSO settlement function and applies a multilateral TSO-TSO model. verdict.gold_reason: Article 22(2) of Regulation 2017/2195 says the imbalance netting platform consists of the imbalance netting process function and the TSO-TSO settlement function and applies a multilateral TSO-TSO model. Articles 19(2), 20(2) and 21(2) give the other platforms an activation optimisation function and common merit order lists, so the contrast in the reference answer is supported.

other_articles.why: Describes the imbalance netting process (reducing simultaneous counteracting FRR activations) but does not describe a Europe-wide platform or contrast it with merit order lists.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question wording is a paraphrase, but the imbalance netting platform is the only one that fits.
